label: PHASE10B_NO_OBSTACLE_CONTROL
scope: Oracle geometry evaluation; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim; no claim of identical paired RGB
run_order: index, delay 0 then750ms, CURV then GRAPH-v6

c6.x_source: actual B at Graph dispatch; retain observation x separately
c6.x_bins_rule: [0,2),[2,4),[4,6),[6,8]; outside retained in separate bin and pooled statistics
c6.population: all GRAPH-v6 calls in Phase9 D750 indices1..8 and D0 indices1..4 plus Phase10B all8 Graph runs
c6.nonconvergence_denominator: all submitted calls; independent solver success flag, initialization rejection and terminal-unapplied separate; also report solver-only denominator
c6.endpoint_edit: (solver endpoint minus FRESH endpoint) dot B-forward; solver output vs accepted application distinguished
c6.condition_a: short nonconvergence rate >= 2*long rate; if long=0 then short must be >0; missing length class => INCONCLUSIVE
c6.condition_b: at least half of valid failed GRAPH-v6 runs have strictly more than half of last10s submitted calls short; zero calls count as not demonstrated
c6.interpretation: descriptive association; endpoint progress is a soft cost, length is not endpoint forward projection; no causal proof

route_metrics.interval_convention: 72Hz pose at interval start held until next pose; final sample has no duration
route_metrics.curv_slow_fraction: CURV target<0.2 over valid non-endpoint PP control duration; actual v<0.2 separately
route_metrics.topomap: all actual inference IDs at observation time; optional switch time; count closest and subgoal backward steps separately

decisions.ROUTE_FAILURE_WITHOUT_OBSTACLE: SUPPORTED if any of four method-delay groups has >=2 valid navigation failures; all four groups require >=3 valid runs else INCONCLUSIVE
decisions.GRAPH_SPECIFIC_ROUTE_FAILURE: SUPPORTED if Graph valid failures >= CURV valid failures+2 at either delay; all four groups require >=3 valid runs else INCONCLUSIVE
decisions.C6_SHORT_CHUNK_CONFLICT: conditions a AND b; each Phase9 and Phase10B GRAPH delay group requires >=3 valid runs, both length bins nonempty and at least one valid Graph failure; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
decisions.technical_failures: excluded from scientific failure counts; never imputed SUCCESS/timeout; no retry
decisions.conservative_stop: preserve explicit non-overlap conservative stop category, count as navigation failure, not geometric collision

plot_selection: First failed Phase10B GRAPH by delay/index; otherwise first failed Phase9 GRAPH; if none, first GRAPH trajectory labeled no failure
